concepts.learning_objective: Define oxidation and reduction in terms of addition or removal of oxygen, hydrogen or electronegative elements.
Identify the oxidising and reducing agent in a reaction using the classical definitions.

topics.title: Redox reactions in terms of electron transfer

concepts.learning_objective: Explain oxidation as loss and reduction as gain of electrons using half reactions.
Use competitive electron transfer experiments to compare the tendency of metals to release electrons.
Apply the rules to calculate the oxidation number of an element in a compound or ion.
Identify oxidation, reduction, oxidant and reductant from changes in oxidation number.
Classify redox reactions as combination, decomposition or displacement reactions.
Recognise disproportionation reactions and the oxidation states that allow them.

topics.title: Balancing redox reactions, titrations and limitations

concepts.learning_objective: Balance redox equations by the oxidation number and half-reaction methods.
Explain how end points are detected in permanganate, dichromate and iodometric titrations.
Describe a Daniell cell, its electrodes, salt bridge and direction of electron flow.
Use standard electrode potentials to compare oxidising and reducing strengths.
